{{Top|leg}}
The '''waveform''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] technique used by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] adepts of the [[Order of Shasa]]. Inspired by the oceans of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], waveform techniques allowed Order devotees to enhance telekinetic abilities by manipulating the natural wave patterns in nature and the particles of the surrounding environment. Similar in principle to [[Alter Environment]], it was applied to a much more personal scale, bolstering Force pushes and other telekinetic skills.
